competitors.name: CleanMyMac
competitors.whatItIs: A paid all-in-one Mac maintenance app from MacPaw that cleans junk, checks for malware and manages performance.

prices.note: Store shows a coupon applied; discounts apply to the first year only

free-use.note: The download is free. The pages do not state what runs without a plan.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose CleanMyMac if you want malware scanning, software updates and performance tools in the same window as the cleanup.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want to preview every path before anything moves, keep the command line free with no limits, and pay for the app only when the Free plan's monthly runs are not enough.

competitors.name: DaisyDisk
competitors.whatItIs: A disk space analyser that draws your disk as a sunburst map so you can find and delete the largest files yourself.

prices.note: The vendor's own site states a one-time licence fee for the stand-alone edition but shows no figure on the pages we checked

free-use.note: Free trial: you can browse the map; deleting needs the paid app.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose DaisyDisk if you want to see your whole disk as a map and decide file by file what goes, with no cleanup presets at all.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if the space you lose is in caches, logs and the data apps left behind, and you want numbered sections that find those for you and show the paths first.

competitors.name: OnyX
competitors.whatItIs: A donationware maintenance utility from Titanium Software with one build per macOS version, covering cleaning, system checks and hidden settings.

prices.note: Free to download and use; donations optional

open-source.note: Free to copy and share. The page bars changing it for distribution.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose OnyX if you also want to verify system files, rebuild databases and change hidden Finder, Dock and Safari settings from one free utility.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want one script that runs on any macOS since Big Sur, a dry run that lists each path before it is touched, and an orphan scan for the data apps left behind.

competitors.name: AppCleaner
competitors.whatItIs: A small drag-and-drop uninstaller from FreeMacSoft that finds the files an app spread around your Mac and deletes them with the app.

prices.note: No price on the pages we checked; direct download links and a Donate link

orphan-files.note: Removes related files along with an app. No stated scan for apps already gone.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose AppCleaner if all you want is to drop one app on a window and remove it together with its related files.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if the apps are already gone and their data is still there, or if caches, logs and build folders are what fill the disk; section 12 finds the leftovers and section 21 reviews unused apps.

competitors.name: CCleaner for Mac
competitors.whatItIs: The Mac edition of CCleaner from Gen Digital, with a free tier for junk, duplicates and uninstalls and a paid tier for photo analysis and scheduled browser cleaning.
competitors.strongerThere: Choose CCleaner for Mac if you also want duplicate photo cleanup, scheduled browser privacy cleaning, and the same brand on your PC and Android phone.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want developer caches, Docker, Xcode, stale build folders and orphaned app data covered in one place, with the exact paths shown before a run.

competitors.name: Pearcleaner
competitors.whatItIs: A free, source-available Mac app uninstaller with an orphaned file search, a Homebrew manager and a development environment manager.

prices.note: Source-available under Apache 2.0 with Commons Clause

open-source.note: Source-available under Apache 2.0 with Commons Clause.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose Pearcleaner if you want a free native uninstaller with a right-click Finder extension, an orphan search and Homebrew and plugin managers in one app.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you also need caches, logs, Docker, Xcode and stale builds handled, an actively released command line under MIT, and a dry run you can read before deciding.

competitors.name: Sensei
competitors.whatItIs: A paid system monitor from Cindori with a cleaning tab, an uninstaller, drive health reports and benchmarks.
competitors.strongerThere: Choose Sensei if hardware monitoring matters as much as cleanup: CPU, GPU, battery, thermals, S.M.A.R.T. drive health and disk benchmarks in the menu bar.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want the cleanup itself to be free and inspectable, with a numbered section for each kind of file and a report of what each run moved or removed.

competitors.name: MacKeeper
competitors.whatItIs: A subscription Mac suite from Clario that bundles cleanup and an uninstaller with antivirus, a VPN, adware blocking and identity monitoring.

prices.note: First-year price shown with a discount; the page states subsequent payments of $95.40 annually
First-year price shown with a discount; the page states subsequent payments of $119.40 annually

free-use.note: The Free column shows cleanup limited to one week or one time.

competitors.strongerThere: Choose MacKeeper if you want antivirus, a VPN, breach monitoring and 24/7 chat support in the same subscription as the cleanup.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if cleanup is the whole job: caches, logs, orphaned data and unused apps, free on the command line, with every path listed before a run and nothing else bundled in.

competitors.name: GrandPerspective
competitors.whatItIs: An open-source utility under the GPL that draws disk usage as a tree map and lets you delete files and folders from the view.

prices.note: Same app; the page says the App Store copy supports distribution costs

competitors.strongerThere: Choose GrandPerspective if you want a free, open-source tree map of your disk and prefer to pick the large files yourself.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want the known space-wasters found by category, caches, logs, orphaned app data and stale builds, each previewed as a list of paths before you confirm.

competitors.name: MacCleaner Pro
competitors.whatItIs: A paid bundle of six Nektony cleanup tools, including an app uninstaller, a disk space analyser and a cache and log cleaner.

prices.note: The page states both a subscription and a one-time purchase; the figures load by script and were not readable on the pages we checked

competitors.strongerThere: Choose MacCleaner Pro if you want a notarised bundle with a visual disk analyser, a duplicate finder and a memory cleaner alongside the cache, log and app cleanup.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want cache, log and orphan cleanup free and under MIT on the command line, with a dry run that prints every path before the real run.

competitors.name: BuhoCleaner
competitors.whatItIs: A paid Mac cleaner from Dr. Buho with a one-tap Flash Clean, an app uninstaller with leftover removal, a disk space analyser and startup item controls.

prices.note: Sale price; the store shows $39.99 struck through
Sale price; the store shows $67.99 struck through
Sale price; the store shows $189.99 struck through

competitors.strongerThere: Choose BuhoCleaner if you want a notarised app with a one-tap clean, a visual disk analyser and a menu bar monitor for RAM, CPU and fan speed.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you would rather read the list before the clean than tap once, want logs, Docker, Xcode and stale builds covered, and want the command line free with no limit.

competitors.name: mac-cleanup-py
competitors.whatItIs: An open-source Python command-line script under Apache 2.0 that clears caches and deletes logs through a list of named modules.
competitors.strongerThere: Choose mac-cleanup-py if you already run Python and want a module-per-tool cache cleaner you can install with pip or Homebrew.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose macleanup if you want no Python or Node needed for a checkout run, orphaned app data and unused apps covered, Trash-first removal where it applies, and a desktop app that runs the same script in a window.
